shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
small figures/emblems arranged in a horizontal band across the upper zone
rows of small repeated incised signs suggesting script
vertically stacked registers with a plainer lower zone
justification: Both concentrate a horizontal band of small emblem-like figures and rows of sign-like incisions in the upper zone above a broader, plainer or densely inscribed lower field, and both include circular/disc motifs. The manner and scale differ sharply: A is bold, deeply modelled relief on a rounded free-standing block whose forms are few and large, while B is a fine, shallow, miniature-scale panel of dense repetitive text carved into an irregular rock face.
